notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (9)': CCT/MFD, Carbonite Chamber Console, Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber, Cloud City: Security Tower, 'Frozen Han', Prepared Defenses, Crush The Rebellion, Imperial Arrest Order (posted 'IAO') and Mobilization Points; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
'Frozen Han' matches no Dark card (the Light Han Solo would be a captive, not a deck card); kept as posted and marked UNKNOWN.

Posted 'AC,' dested Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (the strategy drains there with M'iiyoom Onith); 'DB 94,' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'East Platform' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Lando' the Dark Cloud City Lando Calrissian; 'M'iom'Onith' M'iiyoom Onith; 'Ugslote' Ugloste; 'Xixor' Prince Xizor; 'Palpy x3 (DS2)' Emperor Palpatine; 'ZiMH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.

Qty 60 as published; the 'Interrupts (16)' header lists 14 Interrupts. Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith x3, Emperor Palpatine x3 and Vader's Lightsaber x3 are kept as published (the strategy explains the extra sabers).
The post says the author would play the deck at a tournament 'this saturday' (no result), so it is filed as general.
